mapper.select: SELECT ba.bank_account_id, ba.bank_account_name, ba.bank_account_num, ba.bank_branch_name, ba.bank_full_name, ba.bank_account_type FROM hls_bp_master_bank_account ba, hls_bp_master bm WHERE bm.bp_id = ba.bp_id and bm.bp_code = #{bpCode}

SELECT hbmba.bank_account_id, hbmba.bp_id, hbmba.bank_account_code , hbmba.bank_account_name , hbmba.bank_account_num , hbmba.tss_bank_code tssBankCodeN, hbmba.bank_full_name , hbmba.bank_branch_name, hbmba.currency, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code_value=hbmba.currency and v.code='CHS.CURRENCY_TYPE') currency_n, hbmba.account_nature, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code_value=hbmba.account_nature and v.code='BANK_TYPE_BP') account_nature_n, hbmba.cnaps_code, hbmba.swift_code, hbmba.account_start_date, hbmba.account_end_date, hbmba.tss_bank_num , hbmba.country_id , hbmba.province_id , hbmba.city_id , hbmba.district_id , hbmba.tss_bank_code, hbmba.enabled_flag, fc.description countryIdN, fp.description provinceIdN, fci.description cityIdN, fd.description districtIdN FROM hls_bp_master_bank_account hbmba LEFT JOIN fnd_country fc ON fc.country = hbmba.country_id LEFT JOIN fnd_province fp ON fp.province = hbmba.province_id LEFT JOIN fnd_city fci ON fci.city = hbmba.city_id LEFT JOIN fnd_district fd on fd.district = hbmba.district_id where hbmba.bp_id = #{bpId}

SELECT hbmba.bank_account_id, hbmba.bp_id, hbmba.bank_account_code , hbmba.bank_account_name , hbmba.bank_account_num , hbmba.tss_bank_code tssBankCodeN, hbmba.bank_full_name , hbmba.bank_branch_name, hbmba.currency, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code_value=hbmba.currency and v.code='CHS.CURRENCY_TYPE') currency_n, hbmba.account_nature, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code_value=hbmba.account_nature and v.code='NATURE_OF_ACCOUNT') account_nature_n, hbmba.cnaps_code, hbmba.swift_code, hbmba.account_start_date, hbmba.account_end_date, hbmba.tss_bank_num , hbmba.country_id , hbmba.province_id , hbmba.city_id , hbmba.district_id , hbmba.tss_bank_code, hbmba.enabled_flag, fc.description countryIdN, fp.description provinceIdN, fci.description cityIdN, fd.description districtIdN, hbmba.primary_flag FROM hls_bp_master_bank_account hbmba LEFT JOIN fnd_country fc ON fc.country = hbmba.country_id LEFT JOIN fnd_province fp ON fp.province = hbmba.province_id LEFT JOIN fnd_city fci ON fci.city = hbmba.city_id LEFT JOIN fnd_district fd on fd.district = hbmba.district_id where hbmba.bp_id = #{bpId}
mapper.update: update hls_bp_master_bank_account ha set ha.ebs_business_code=#{ebsBusinessCode} where ha.bp_id=#{bpId} and ha.bank_account_num=#{bankAccountNum}
mapper.select: SELECT ba.bank_account_id, ba.bp_id, ba.bank_account_num, ba.bank_account_name, ba.currency, ba.bank_full_name, ba.bank_branch_name, ba.country, ba.REMARKS, hbm.BP_NAME, hbm.BP_CODE, (select fp.description from fnd_province fp where fp.province = ba.province) province, (select fc.description from fnd_city fc where fc.city = ba.city) city, (select fd.description from fnd_district fd where fd.district = ba.district) district, ba.debt_bank_id, (select hdb.BANK_NAME from hls_debt_deduction_bank hdb where hdb.BANK_ID = ba.debt_bank_id) debt_bank_name, (select hdb.BANK_CODE from hls_debt_deduction_bank hdb where hdb.BANK_ID = ba.debt_bank_id) debt_bank_code, ba.debt_flag, ba.bank_account_type FROM hls_bp_master_bank_account ba join HLS_BP_MASTER hbm ON ba.BP_ID = hbm.BP_ID left join prj_project_bp fpb ON hbm.BP_ID = fpb.BP_ID where fpb.bp_type = 'TENANT' and fpb.bank_account_id = ba.bank_account_id and ba.enabled_flag = 'Y' and fpb.project_Id = #{projectId} and rownum=1
select ba.* from hls_bp_master_bank_account ba where ba.bp_id = #{bpId}

SELECT pp.bank_account_num, pp.bank_account_name, pp.bank_branch_name, pp.bank_full_name, (select pq.lease_start_date from prj_quotation pq where pq.source_document_id = pp.project_id and pq.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = 'PRJ_PROJECT' and rownum = 1) invest_date FROM prj_project pp where pp.project_Id = #{projectId}

SELECT ba.bank_account_id, ba.bp_id, ba.bank_account_num, ba.bank_account_name, ba.bank_branch_name, ba.bank_full_name FROM prj_project pp left join hls_bp_master_bank_account ba on ba.bp_id = pp.manufacturer_id left join hls_product_definition pd on pd.bp_id = pp.manufacturer_id where pd.payment_bp_type = 'MANUFACTURER' and ba.enabled_flag = 'Y' and pd.enabled_flag = 'Y' and pp.project_Id = #{projectId} and rownum=1
